termination_review.private_group_guard: os.getpgrp()==os.getpid() prevents shared caller group cleanup
termination_review.revised_observer_cleanup: After a received termination signal it closes report, then kills its owned group including itself. Timeout/cancellation preserve native_returncode=-15 and termination_signal=15; observer itself terminates by SIGKILL. Stubborn descendant leak reproduced before fix and absent after fix.
termination_review.stubborn_native: Existing runtime escalates group SIGKILL after two seconds, cleaning native and descendant; no resource report can be saved when observer itself is forcibly killed.

cpu_and_rss_scope_review.cpu: user/system CPU of native child and descendants whose usage propagates through waited ancestors; excludes observer, MCP server and model latency. Fresh observer has no previous waited children.
cpu_and_rss_scope_review.rss: largest individual waited child/propagated descendant peak, not simultaneous process-tree peak. Darwin measured bytes agree exactly with native waited-child ru_maxrss. Linux KiB multiplication by 1024 is supported by Linux man-pages documentation, but no Linux runtime was available for empirical verification.

limitations: No empirical Cloud/Linux execution; upload and actual Linux resource report remain operator checks.
Current Cloud template has no prior P2A_RSCRIPT; arbitrary custom prior launcher fidelity is unsupported because observer selects PATH Rscript. Removal restores previous configured value.
Descendants that create a new session escape the existing process-group contract.
Forced SIGKILL before report closure cannot generate a complete report.
Installer preserves edits made between install and removal; it does not synchronize against simultaneous settings writes.
